mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a 3-month average growth rate above 200k, the tightening labor market drives wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased costs.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when trigger is met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain resilience, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturers' profitability improves.
evidence_refs: fact:historical supply chain disruptions impact on manufacturing
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 6-month MA are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% on a quarterly basis indicates strong aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer and business spending boost corporate revenues.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly growth > 3%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% indicates a tightening monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce consumption and investment.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when trigger is met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 2 months, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence surges.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market impact on consumer confidence
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns when UNRATE decrease > 0.5% over 2 months are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% on a monthly basis, signaling strong consumer spending, leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as retailers and food services companies see increased revenues.
evidence_refs: doc:Consumer spending impact on retail sector
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 25% of instances when RSAFS monthly growth > 5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
